doc.title: Marian McPartland interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, April 26, 1997

title: Gripes about the music business
summary: She wants more money and dislikes motels with no room service.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: That’s a good one. Do you have any gripes about the music business that you’d like to put on film?

Oh, well I’d like more money. I don’t know. I can’t think of one offhand. I mean it’s terrible I know I have some, but I can’t think of anything really serious except being put in a motel with no room service. That’s probably one of my most serious gripes.
